She looked at the council with steady eyes and spoke a dare into the charged air: “If the lantern’s light has left the world, then we must redraw the map of where to find it.”

A raven, its beak catching glints of frost, dropped a slip of parchment at Mira’s feet. On it lay a sketch of a gate half-buried in ice, a path that wove through the northern night. The call was clear: venture beyond the edge of maps, through ice and shadow, to recover what was lost and to learn why the world whispered of danger yet refused to tell the full truth.
